name: anilist-my-proxy
description: Categorized AniList GraphQL proxy with paginated endpoints for currently-airing, top-airing, trending, upcoming, recently-completed, most-favourite, new-added, and popular anime, plus Jikan-style item endpoints /api/{id}/full and /api/{id}/episodes that accept both MAL and AniList ids. Returns both AniList id and MyAnimeList idMal.
author: Varvoul
